rules.sentence: When `CR-STATUS` is `'B'` (`CR-BLOCKED`), it sets `RS-RESULT` to `RS-CARD-BLOCKED`, sets `RS-MESSAGE` to `'CARD BLOCKED'`, and returns to its caller.

When `CR-STATUS` is not `'B'` (not `CR-BLOCKED`) and `AO-STATUS` is not `'O'` (not `AO-OPEN`), it sets `RS-RESULT` to `RS-ACCOUNT-NOT-OPEN`, sets `RS-MESSAGE` to `'ACCOUNT NOT OPEN'`, and returns to its caller.

When `CR-STATUS` is not `'B'` (not `CR-BLOCKED`) and `AO-STATUS` is `'O'` (`AO-OPEN`), it sets `RS-RESULT` to `RS-APPROVED`, sets `RS-MESSAGE` to `'BALANCE'`, sets `RS-BALANCE` to `AO-BALANCE`, runs `ADD AO-BALANCE AO-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT GIVING WS-AVAILABLE`, subtracts `AO-HOLDS` from `WS-AVAILABLE`, sets `RS-AVAILABLE` to `WS-AVAILABLE`, and returns to its caller.
